prompt_1: Write a continuous science-fiction short story set on a generation ship traveling for 500 years. Use numbered chapters (Chapter 1, Chapter 2, …) and write at least 8 full chapters. Each chapter must be at least 1,200 words. Include dialogue, scene description, and plot progression. Do not stop early, do not summarize, do not ask questions, and do not include a meta note about length. Start writing immediately.
prompt_2: Write a detailed fantasy world encyclopedia for the kingdom of Aelthara. Create exactly 25 numbered entries covering cities, rivers, mountains, guilds, religions, wars, legends, flora, fauna, and notable rulers. Each entry must include a title, at least 4 paragraphs of descriptive prose, one historical anecdote, and one quote attributed to a local figure. Write in an immersive reference-book style, not bullet summaries. Continue entry by entry until all 25 are complete. Do not stop early, do not summarize, and do not ask questions.
prompt_3: Write the complete ship's log of the 1892 Antarctic expedition aboard the vessel Meridian. Produce exactly 40 dated journal entries in chronological order, from departure to return. Each entry must be at least 3 paragraphs long and include weather observations, crew interactions, discoveries or setbacks, and the captain's personal reflections. Use the heading format "Entry N — [date]" for every entry. Write in first-person nautical prose. Continue until all 40 entries are finished. Do not skip dates, do not summarize multiple days into one entry, and do not stop early.
